The core layer is `@plutocms/pluto`. It gives the foundation of the CMS. Other layers plug into it.

## Layer kinds

**Core layer.** It owns the admin shell, the content model, the extension registry, permissions, mail, i18n, and the single Tailwind build.

**Backend layers.** They handle data, authentication, and APIs. `@plutocms/supabase` is the first one. Other providers are possible in the future.

**Feature layers.** They add domain features on top of a backend layer. `@plutocms/supabase-shop`, `@plutocms/supabase-blog`, and `@plutocms/supabase-storage` are feature layers. `@plutocms/nuxt-content` is a feature layer on top of core. It needs no backend layer.

**Support layers.** `@plutocms/ui` has shared Vue components. `@plutocms/utils` has shared helpers. Other layers extend them.

::note
A layer brings its upstream layers. `@plutocms/supabase` extends `@plutocms/pluto` and `@plutocms/utils`. `@plutocms/supabase-shop` extends `@plutocms/supabase`, `@plutocms/ui`, and `@plutocms/utils`. `@plutocms/supabase-blog` extends `@plutocms/supabase`, `@plutocms/supabase-storage`, and `@plutocms/ui`. `@plutocms/nuxt-content` extends `@plutocms/pluto`. You do not list them again in your app.
::

## What core gives

- `<PlutoRoot>`. It wraps your app in `app.vue`. It includes the admin navbar, `NuxtLayout`, `NuxtLoadingIndicator`, and the base styles.
- `<ColorModeButton>`. A light and dark mode toggle with no configuration.
- The admin shell: the `/admin` route, the `/admin/login` page, the route guard, and the navbar.
- `<PlutoNavbarAdmin>` and `<PlutoNavbarAdminActions>`. They give structure for actions from other layers.
- `definePlutoExtension`. One function that a layer calls to plug into the admin.
- The [GitHub CMS](/github-cms). An optional standalone CMS with Markdown files in a GitHub repository.

## Extend the layers

Extend only the top layer that you use. It brings the layers below it. This example uses the shop layer. It brings `@plutocms/supabase` and `@plutocms/pluto`:

```ts [nuxt.config.ts]
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  extends: [['@plutocms/supabase-shop', { install: true }]]
})
```

An app with no database extends `@plutocms/pluto` alone. The `{ install: true }` option makes Nuxt install the dependencies of the layer.

In `package.json`, the app needs only that top layer, with `nuxt`, `vue`, and `vue-router`.

## Read the data

You can read the data in two ways:

- With composables, inside a Nuxt app.
- With the REST routes that the layers expose. Core has generic content routes under `/api/_pluto/content/`. They are for the admin. See [Content model](/core/content-model).

For a public read, write your own endpoint, or use the public read routes of the [GitHub CMS](/github-cms/public-read).
